source: Hand length by percentile: Pheasant & Haslegrave, Bodyspace (3rd ed., 2006), British adults aged 19-65. Grip rules of thumb: power-grip handles of about 30-50 mm diameter are the usual handbook range (Pheasant & Haslegrave; Kroemer, Fitting the Task to the Human); the per-hand-length ratios below put the centre of that range at a mid-size hand and are working values to be confirmed with foam mock-ups. Trigger reach: handgun trigger reach (back of grip to trigger face) is commonly 66-74 mm for adult hands; 0.37 x hand length gives that range.

grip.notes: grip angle: the handle's tilt back from the line of sight that keeps the wrist near neutral when pointing (typical pistol grips 15-22 deg).
